info.name: dkPlus API
info.description:
The dk Plus API allows you to connect to a wide range of information from the dkERP system and utilize the speed of our JSON/Rest service and pull information fast and easily.
alternativly if you need more features you can connect to the dkSoap Webservice.

## dkPlus  
URL :  [link](https://www.dkplus.is)  
User : demo@dkplus.is  
Password : Demo123  

## API
URL : https://api.dkplus.is/api/v1  
Token : **3541031f-baf2-4737-a7e8-c66396e5a5e3**  

  
## Remote Desktop Access  
You can access the dkSystem and the data the webservice connects to to analyse the data and the system behind  

Instructions : [link](https://dk.is/instructions-en/)  
Username : dkvistun\demo.developer  
Password : **Code2make**  
  
## Swagger
dk+ API implements swagger that can be used to generate a client or for testing.  
[link](https://api.dkplus.is/swagger)
  
Swagger documentation [here](https://www.swagger.io)  
Swagger Generate Client [here](https://editor.swagger.io)  
  
## Paging  
With many modules you can use paging to get all data for example customers  
stating with page **1** and loop through the pages until there are no more results
but the API also implements RFC5988 for Web Linking in the reposen headers 
* First
* Previos
* Next
* Last  
  
**NOTE:** Paging is limited to 50.000 documents  
to get more documents use filter/query to limit the result for example createdAfter and createdBefore and page results.
 
This might come in handy for example if you would like to display a progress bar or see the current status of a pagnation.  
[link](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5988)


## YOUR SOLUTION  
To get your solution and company listed on our marketplace  
[Link](https://dk.is/lausnatorg/)  
Send an email with the following  
* Subject = Marketplace
* Supply information regarding you company and product  
* Contact Information

item.name: Tokens

header.description:
Language for the invoice generation
**Optional** Header Parameter

request.description:
An email will be sent with the invoice in the body as HTML along with an attachment .pdf  
supply an email address and subject.  
  
## Sender Detail  
By default the email will be sent by no-reply@dkplus.is unless company email has been configured for the company in dkPlus  
then that email address will be used and and the sender display will be the dkPlus user fullname along with the company name.  
**Example : ** Test Employee - Demo Company  

## Properties  
* Priority - Enum None(**0**), Highest(**1**), High(**2**), Normal(**3**), Low(**4**), Lowest(**5**)
* To - string
* Cc - string
* Bcc - string
* Subject - string
  
**Note** : Multiple Email addressess can be specified and sepirated with , or ;

item.description:
## Using Tokens  
All token methods requer Basic Auth to work with token(Create,List companies, Remove)  

Other methods need Bearer authorization  
**Authorization: bearer xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx** 

This is the most vital part of using the service.
your application can request a token to be used for communication with dkPlus or alternativly you can log into  
[link](https://www.dkplus.is) and generate a token to be used.  
once a token is requered you will use it for all web request made from this point.

request.description: Use this method to get general ledger accounts.

Use this method to get transactions pages for a specified General Ledger Account  
## Optional Url Parameters
* **int** Page - default 1
* **int** Count - default 100

##  Query Parameters
* **string** dim1
* **string** voucher
* **string** reference
* **datetime** createdAfter
* **datetime** createdBefore
* **datetime** dueAfter

## Properties
* **string** Code 
* **string** Description
* **int** Period - //optional default to this year
* **options** Options //Optional
* **Array Line** Lines 
  
### Options  
* **bool** Post //optional - default false
* **bool** GenerateVoucher //optional - default true
  
### Line 
* **string** Account
* **double** Amount
* **string** Currency  //optional - default company currency
* **DateTime** Date //optional - default today
* **DateTime** DueDate //optional
* **string** Dim1 //optional if company settings do not enforce
* **string** Reference //optional
* **string** Text //optional
* **string** Voucher //optional
* **JournalType** Type
  
### JournalType  
This property can be set as the integer value or name as string  
"Type":1 or "Type":"Customer"
* GeneralLedger (**0**)
* Customer (**1**)
* Vendor (**2**)
* Project (**3**)
* Payroll (**4**)
* FixedAssets (**5**)
* MemberPayments (**6**),
* BankTransaction (**7**)
* Supporter (**8**)
* Booking (**9**)

Use this method to get transactions pages
##  Parameters
* **string** account
* **string** dim1
* **string** voucher
* **string** reference
* **datetime** createdAfter
* **datetime** createdBefore
* **datetime** dueAfter

## Description
Using this function allows you to retrive an attachment that has been assigned to a customer  
  
### Usage  
Supply the customer number and id of the attachment in the URL  
this will return a status OK along with the attachment data
* ContentType - Mime Type
* ContentDisposition - FileName
* Byte content of the file
